_README: Changelog-only title rewrites, keyed by pull-request number. The pull request keeps the title it merged with; this gives the changelog entry a conventional-commit type, which is what puts it in a section. Add an entry whenever release_notes.py leaves something in ### Uncategorized. Keys starting with _ are comments.
